ontario-social-studies-g6-all-strands.documentVersion: Ontario Social Studies, History, and Geography Curriculum (2026)

standards.unit: Heritage and Identity: Communities in Canada, Past and Present
standards.strand: Heritage and Identity: Communities in Canada, Past and Present
standards.summaryText: assess contributions to Canadian identities made by various groups and communities, including First Nations, Métis, and Inuit communities, and by various features of Canadian communities and regions
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess contributions to Canadian identities made by various groups and communities, including First Nations, Métis, and Inuit communities, and by various features of Canadian communities and regions
standards.curriculumFocus: Heritage and Identity: Communities in Canada, Past and Present

standards.unit: Heritage and Identity: Communities in Canada, Past and Present
standards.strand: Heritage and Identity: Communities in Canada, Past and Present
standards.summaryText: use the social studies inquiry process to investigate different perspectives on the historical and/or contemporary experiences of a few distinct communities, including First Nations, Métis, and/or Inuit communities, in Canada
standards.officialOutcomeText: use the social studies inquiry process to investigate different perspectives on the historical and/or contemporary experiences of a few distinct communities, including First Nations, Métis, and/or Inuit communities, in Canada
standards.curriculumFocus: Heritage and Identity: Communities in Canada, Past and Present

standards.unit: Heritage and Identity: Communities in Canada, Past and Present
standards.strand: Heritage and Identity: Communities in Canada, Past and Present
standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of significant experiences of, and major changes and aspects of life in, various historical and contemporary communities, including First Nations, Métis, and Inuit communities, in Canada
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of significant experiences of, and major changes and aspects of life in, various historical and contemporary communities, including First Nations, Métis, and Inuit communities, in Canada
standards.curriculumFocus: Heritage and Identity: Communities in Canada, Past and Present

standards.unit: People and Environments: Canada's Interactions with the Global Community
standards.strand: People and Environments: Canada's Interactions with the Global Community
standards.summaryText: explain the importance of international cooperation in addressing global issues, and evaluate the effectiveness of selected actions by Canada and Canadian citizens in the international arena
standards.officialOutcomeText: explain the importance of international cooperation in addressing global issues, and evaluate the effectiveness of selected actions by Canada and Canadian citizens in the international arena
standards.curriculumFocus: People and Environments: Canada's Interactions with the Global Community

standards.unit: People and Environments: Canada's Interactions with the Global Community
standards.strand: People and Environments: Canada's Interactions with the Global Community
standards.summaryText: use the social studies inquiry process to investigate some global issues of political, social, economic, and/or environmental importance, their impact on the global community, and responses to the issues
standards.officialOutcomeText: use the social studies inquiry process to investigate some global issues of political, social, economic, and/or environmental importance, their impact on the global community, and responses to the issues
standards.curriculumFocus: People and Environments: Canada's Interactions with the Global Community

standards.unit: People and Environments: Canada's Interactions with the Global Community
standards.strand: People and Environments: Canada's Interactions with the Global Community
standards.summaryText: describe significant aspects of the involvement of Canada and Canadians in some regions around the world, including the impact of this involvement
standards.officialOutcomeText: describe significant aspects of the involvement of Canada and Canadians in some regions around the world, including the impact of this involvement
standards.curriculumFocus: People and Environments: Canada's Interactions with the Global Community
